title: Control separate music,SFX and haptics preferences without playback side effects
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/SWARM_BENCHMARK.md, docs/DESIGN_RECONCILIATION.md, docs/PILOT100_READY.md and your frozen export contract in docs/PILOT100_UI_CONTRACTS.md before coding. Implement only your owned leaf module using installed React/TypeScript/testing dependencies. Export the exact named component and readonly props/types from index.tsx; keep module-local styles and tests inside that directory. Do not import an unmerged A/B task, edit App.tsx/shared barrels/manifests/task metadata or silently change another contract. This is controlled recipient-safe presentation, not an authority or complete application. Authority state/capabilities and semantic callbacks are supplied; no Firebase/native/store/network calls, secret caching, clock-driven game transitions, asset generation or fabricated success. Use original neutral-frost chrome, semantic HTML/keyboard access and honest unavailable media/provider states. Overlay leaves supply content to the separately composed modal host; do not claim global focus blocking in a content-only leaf. No commits, pushes, PRs, child agents, credentials, cloud deployment or budget changes. Preserve concise handoff, observed validation/failures and unknown costs under the benchmark policy. Render controlled semantic audio toggles and labelled0–1 volume controls; haptics unavailable is explicit. Do not autoplay,fake waveform playback,access native APIs,persist preferences or attach audio files. Own only apps/client/src/pilot100/audio-settings/; provide index.tsx exporting AudioSettings, AudioSettingsProps and any named local types documented for B035. This task consumes part of A045, A082, A085; do not double-count it as a second implementation of that broad work. Run scoped React tests/lint/typecheck and node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full; report actual results and unresolved application integration.
acceptance: Music/SFX toggles and volume callbacks remain independent and constrained to0–1.
Unsupported haptics cannot emit an enable request and explain unavailability.
Rendering/interaction never starts audio or bypasses gesture/system-mute restrictions.
Exact frozen export/readonly props are implemented and scoped lint/typecheck/meaningful React tests plus node tools/benchmark-pilot.mjs --profile full pass; only owned files change.
